name: What is the typical process for an aging-in-place bathroom renovation with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for an aging-in-place bathroom renovation with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process for an aging-in-place bathroom renovation begins with an initial consultation to understand your specific needs and vision. We then move into design planning, often with CAD-supported layouts, to integrate accessibility features while achieving a spa-inspired aesthetic. Following design approval and permit coordination, our experienced team manages the construction, installation, and final walkthrough, ensuring a seamless experience. As a single point of coordination, AKN Design Group unifies design and construction, providing clear communication and accountability from concept to completion for your peace of mind.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, design planning with CAD layouts, permit coordination, construction, and a final walkthrough, all managed by one integrated design-build team.
